def test_selector_preserves_dtypes_pandas_output():
    """Check that selectors keep the input dtypes with pandas output."""
    pd = pytest.importorskip("pandas")
    X = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "a": np.array([1, 2, 3, 4], dtype=np.float16),
            "b": [0, 0, 0, 0],
            "c": pd.Series([0, 1, 0, 1]).astype("category"),
        }
    )
    selector = StepSelector(step=2).set_output(transform="pandas")
    X_out = selector.fit_transform(X)
    assert list(X_out.columns) == ["a", "c"]
    assert X_out["a"].dtype == np.float16
    assert X_out["c"].dtype == "category"
EOF
